author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am fully prepared to keep the experiment tracking process manual, done by hand, if it guarantees that the deployment registry is fully governed. I want the registry to be automated so that every model version is traceable and reproducible without human error. I will accept the friction of manual tracking for my own experiments, provided the final registry enforces strict sign off. This way, store managers can verify exactly which model produced their order suggestion. I am giving up the convenience of automated tracking for my personal workflow to secure a fully governed registry that restores trust in the system. The registry must be the automated, governed source of truth.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are giving up the convenience of automated experiment tracking to secure a fully governed and automated deployment registry.
